typing: static, weakly enforced via PICTURE clauses

numeric_model.notes: COMP-3 (packed decimal) and other PICTURE numeric clauses are native, exact fixed-point types

exception_model: none; error signaling via return/status codes (e.g. FILE STATUS, SQLCODE when embedded SQL is present)
concurrency_model: none native to the language; concurrency is provided by the surrounding batch scheduler or CICS/IMS region
native_sql_access: embedded SQL (EXEC SQL) via a precompiler, when the program uses DB2/Oracle embedded SQL
notes: Drafted from general knowledge of the language, not yet checked by a project maintainer. Verify each field before treating target-fit findings derived from this file as final. PERFORM/GOTO/ALTER form COBOL's own control-flow vocabulary and should be reviewed carefully against the actual dialect in use (e.g. mainframe vs. Micro Focus).
